title: Session page: proposal
description: How the session page, /live/ and the voice chat become one live page. Step 0 is built.

add.text:
**Today, side by side at phone width.** Left: [a session's page](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/cloud-voice-app-20261106/). Right: [/live/](/live/).

![The session page today](./today-session-400.png) ![/live/ today](./today-live-400.png)

add.title: Two pages, two engines
add.text: Both extend core `Page`. The session page (`AISessionDetail`, 648 lines) draws its own head and tabs, and reads `session.jsonl` through four JSONL readers written inside the page. /live/ (`LivePage`) gets its data from the page's own item store.

add.title: ✅ Step 0, built: the live tail
add.text: A task added, started or closed now shows on the open session page within 1 s. It needed a reload: on a slow page, `JSONL.live()` gave up after 1.5 s and stopped listening. Fixed in ext/JSONL, not in Page (9782b2db5).

add.title: Reuse from LivePage
add.text: The header with its breadcrumb and gear · the settings page (where the page comes from) · the tasks checklist that ticks live · one scroll area that follows new items · link cards with previews.

add.title: What a session page needs on top
add.text: Its tasks appearing, starting and closing live · the plan (each task's steps under it) · the owner's sentences placed into the task they belong to · its child sessions.

add.title: Three surfaces, one record
add.text: The session page, /live/ and the voice chat (Dictate, chat v3) all show one session record. So: one live page class, three views of the same `Session` item.

add.title: The shape (proposal, not built)
add.caption: Page asks for an item; it never reads a file itself.

add.title: Page stays store-agnostic
add.text: No JSONL code goes into Page. Today the session page has JSONL readers inside it (`SessionPageLog`, `SessionTasks`). The plan moves those reads behind `Session.open(url)` and the item store, so another store can replace JSONL without touching Page.

add.title: Smallest next step (not built yet)
add.text: `SessionPage` at a session's own url: LivePage's header plus its tasks checklist over the record, about 40 lines. The old tabs (Timeline, Cost, …) stay one click away. About $5, one Sonnet build.

add.title: The alternatives
add.text: **LivePage's header in core Page first** (the separate `livepage-into-page` task): every page gets it, then the session page needs only its views. Wins if many pages want it. **Swap only the session page's head**: cheapest, but two engines stay.
